objective: Make stripCitations in packages/runtime/src/instructions/skills.ts handle the three edge cases the Kimi set review found, so the Pi root and role prompts can pass through it safely.
scope: Work only in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-launcher (branch release/0.3.0/feat/pi-launcher). stripCitations removes citation tags from instruction text but skips code spans and fenced blocks and collapses blank lines (LF and CRLF).

Fix and test: (1) a stray backtick must not pair code spans across list items (a code span does not cross a blank line or a new list item, per CommonMark); (2) a fence indented four or more spaces is an indented code block line, not a fence, and an indented code block containing a blank line is left as written; (3) a citation comment on the final line keeps the preceding newline. Add a test for each that fails without the fix.
Add one sentence to docs/development.md, in the instructions section, stating that stripCitations leaves code spans and fenced blocks as written.
Another writer will call stripCitations on the root and role prompts; keep its signature.
constraints: Edit only the ownership paths; no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
Run bunx --no-install mise run build and bunx --no-install mise run verify and report exit codes and counts, and whether build changed generated output (if the plugin skills change, say which files).
Write the diff to /home/user/holyagent-notes/launcher-c.diff and give it as diff-file evidence.
Start each evidence line with the criterion text, then a colon.
